mechanism.claim: During an already high-volatility BTC day, an extreme excess of six-hour five-minute realized variance over variance measured from six non-overlapping one-hour returns identifies offsetting microstructure noise; the net six-hour move should reverse over twelve hours.
mechanism.side: opposite the strict nonzero completed six-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVVRR measures cross-scale variance non-additivity. It does not use temporal variance concentration/release, jump scores, sign entropy, semivariance, candle wicks, external feeds, or a prior candidate control.

clock.decision: each completed 5m bar; accepted onset enters at the next exact 5m open
clock.fine_variance: sum squared close-to-close log returns over prior 72 completed returns
clock.coarse_variance: sum squared returns of the six consecutive non-overlapping 12-bar blocks ending at the same decision bar
clock.noise_ratio: fine_variance/coarse_variance; coarse variance must be positive
clock.calibration: 2023H1 source-only high-volatility q60 and noise-ratio q85; no candidate incidence or post-entry prices
clock.onset: false-to-true noise ratio >= q85 while high-volatility >= q60 and the completed six-hour return is finite and nonzero
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no threshold, side, hold, or gate repair
